description: This file defines the ChartService class in the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin, providing methods to retrieve employee distribution data by subunit and location, including calculations for unassigned employees and handling top subunits/locations with 'others' category.

classes.name: ChartService
classes.description: Service class for fetching and processing employee distribution data related to dashboard visualizations, including handling top N entries and calculating unassigned employees.

methods.name: getChartDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of ChartDao; initializes it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Fetches employee distribution data by subunit, sorts it, limits to specified number, and aggregates others.

methods.name: getLocationUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Calculates unassigned employees based on total active employees and assigned employees in provided location counts.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Fetches employee distribution data by location, determines unassigned employee count, and manages top N locations.
